You, yes, YOU!  Should submit a proposal to SoCalLinuxExpo!  Especially if you're a first-time speaker, or have never been to SCALE.

Join our CfP help session tommorrow at noon Pacific Time:

https://www.socallinuxexpo.org/scale/blog/need-help-your-talk-proposal-join-thursdays-qa 

... and we'll get you started writing a proposal.
